title: Hall of Mysteries
wikitext:
[[Image:Hall of Mysteries.jpg|thumb|Hall of Mysteries]]

'''Hall of Mysteries''' is the center of arcane and divine power in the dwarven kingdom of [[Ironforge]]. It houses several [[mage]], [[paladin]], and [[priest]] trainers and a few quest givers.
